pokedexPage.subtitle: {{count}} Pokémon total
pokedexPage.loadListError: Failed to load the Pokémon list.
pokedexPage.introP1: Look up types, stats, and evolution for Pokémon you got in the lookalike test. Data comes from the public PokeAPI and matches Pokémon included in this service (e.g. gens 1–4 and Mega forms).
pokedexPage.introP2: Search in Korean where a Korean name exists; otherwise try English. Tap a card to open details.
pokedexPage.bottomLead: Upload a photo and AI ranks Pokémon by similarity. Below are common questions and a simple explanation of how matching works.
pokedexPage.bottomA1: AI analyzes your photo and compares it to official artwork of Pokémon in this service, then shows similarity scores. Face, impression, and color cues are used.
pokedexPage.bottomA2: By default your upload is not stored on our servers. Analysis runs in the browser; you can optionally save only result metadata after login.
pokedexPage.bottomQ3: How does this relate to the lookalike test?
pokedexPage.bottomA3: Search the Pokémon you got to see type, size, evolution, and a short lookalike-style description.
pokedexPage.bottomAiP: The model extracts image features and scores similarity to each Pokémon’s artwork. Type “vibe” and colors matter, not only face shape. Expression-based bonuses can change ordering, especially further down the list.

faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.lead: Frequently asked questions about the Pokémon lookalike finder.
faqPage.howQ1: How do I find my Pokémon lookalike?
faqPage.howA1After: — upload a photo and AI compares it to official art (gens 1–4 and Mega forms included) and shows similarity order. No sign-up required.
faqPage.howA2: Features like face, impression, and color are extracted and compared to each Pokémon image. Type mood and colors also influence the score.
faqPage.howA3: A clear, front-facing face with decent lighting works best. Avoid heavy occlusion or many faces in front.
faqPage.howQ4: Can the order change for the same photo?
faqPage.howA4: Yes — device/browser differences, emotion detection, and type bonuses can shift ranks (especially below the top spots). For fun only.
faqPage.privA1: We aim not to store personal photos. Lookalike analysis runs in your browser; you may save only results after login in “My Results”.
faqPage.privQ2: Can I use the site without logging in?
faqPage.privA2: Yes for the lookalike test and Pokédex. Saving results, ranking, and community require login.
faqPage.privA3After: . We use minimal data for login; saving results is optional.
